ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, $\angle ACD=90^\circ$, $\angle D=15^\circ$, and point $B$ is on the perpendicular bisector of $AD$. If $AC=4$, what is the length of $AB$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since point B is on the perpendicular bisector of AD,\\
it follows that $BA=BD$,\\
which means $\angle D=\angle BAD=15^\circ$\\
Thus, $\angle ABC=\angle D+\angle BAD=30^\circ$\\
Since $\angle ACD=90^\circ$ and $AC=4$,\\
it follows that $AB=2AC=\boxed{8}$

The text gives angle D = 15° in right triangle ACD, so tan 15° = AC/CD = 4/d, hence d = 4 cot 15°. Because B lies on the perpendicular bisector of AD, BA = BD.
